files.dialog.css: .item-dialog{box-sizing:border-box;width:min(800px,calc(100vw - 24px));max-width:none;max-height:calc(100dvh - 24px);padding:0;border:1px solid #aeb8c7;border-radius:12px;overflow:auto;color:#222c3c}.item-dialog::backdrop{background:rgb(15 22 35 / .5)}.dialog-scroll{padding:24px}.item-dialog h1{font-size:22px;margin:0 0 8px}.master-detail{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(160px,1fr) minmax(0,2fr);gap:24px;margin-block:24px}.item-master{min-width:0;margin:0;padding:12px;border:1px solid #ced5df}.item-master label{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:baseline;padding:10px 4px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.item-detail{min-width:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.item-detail h2{margin-top:0;font-size:18px}.item-detail dl{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto minmax(0,1fr);gap:10px}.item-detail dt{font-weight:600}.item-detail dd{margin:0}.item-dialog footer{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}.item-dialog button{font:inherit;padding:10px 14px;border:1px solid #9da9ba;border-radius:6px;background:white}.item-dialog .primary{background:#284da8;color:white}.item-dialog button:disabled{opacity:.5}.item-dialog :focus-visible{outline:3px solid #365dc9;outline-offset:3px}@media(max-width:560px){.master-detail{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}.dialog-scroll{padding:16px}}
